name: feedback
description: Player feedback. The header's flag button (the `feedback` WS message) and the `feedback` verb store a report with where the player was and what they were doing, read from the live player, plus the client's own state. One INSERT per report, a 60 s cooldown per player, an optional Discord webhook (FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK_URL), and a staff inbox in the dev panel.

config.COOLDOWN_MS: 60000: one report a minute per player, in RAM
config.MAX_CLIENT_BYTES: 16000: client telemetry over this is replaced by a size note
config.FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK_URL: env var; unset means no Discord post

dataSchema.note: Runtime table, not in the content registry. The inbox list never selects the JSONB columns.
